design_detail: Make wealth tax permanent and lower threshold
quote_original: Volver permanente el impuesto al patrimonio, disminuir el umbral de pago y eliminar los descuentos que reducen la tarifa efectiva.
quote_en: Make the wealth tax permanent, lower the threshold and remove discounts that reduce the effective rate.
source_title: Lo que no puede quedar por fuera de una nueva propuesta de reforma tributaria
grading_note: Organisation explicitly recommends a permanent wealth tax.

design_detail: Defend and improve existing wealth tax
quote_original: El impuesto al patrimonio puede y debe mejorarse.
quote_en: The wealth tax can and should be improved.
source_title: Dejemos de satanizar el impuesto al patrimonio
grading_note: Author defends the existing wealth tax against elimination in the column.

design_detail: Progressive rates on personal net wealth starting at 84,253 UVT
quote_original: Modifíquese el impuesto al patrimonio a personas naturales y jurídicas de tal manera que las tarifas establecidas en el estatuto tributario tengan un carácter progresivo
quote_en: Modify the wealth tax on individuals and legal entities so that the rates in the tax code are progressive.
source_title: Gaceta del Congreso 1061, propuesta Comunes
grading_note: Legislative report identifies the proposal as Comunes policy.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax for individuals and companies in 2021 proposal
quote_original: También proponen un impuesto al patrimonio de las personas naturales, con una tasa del 1% para los patrimonios de 3.000 millones de pesos
quote_en: They also propose a wealth tax on individuals at 1% for wealth of 3 billion pesos.
source_title: Partido Alianza Verde presentó su propuesta de reforma tributaria
grading_note: News report describes the party proposal and its specific wealth tax.

design_detail: Signed positive report on Bill 066/2021, tax on net wealth for 2022–2025

design_detail: Rates of 0.5%, 1% and 2% on successive wealth brackets
quote_original: Nuestra propuesta es comenzar a cobrar por patrimonios por encima de 1.000 millones, sin derecho a descuentos adicionales.
quote_en: Our proposal is to begin taxing wealth above 1 billion pesos, without additional deductions.
source_title: Los impuestos en Colombia: ¿Qué, cómo, cuánto y cuándo reformarlos?
grading_note: Named co-author explicitly proposes rates and thresholds.

design_detail: Author and presenter of Proyecto de Ley 118/2022 Cámara, 131/2022 Senado (reforma tributaria para la igualdad y la justicia social), which became Ley 2277 de 2022 with the permanent wealth tax (impuesto al patrimonio) on net assets of 72,000 UVT or more.
quote_original: Ministro de Hacienda y Crédito Público - Jose Antonio Ocampo
quote_en: Minister of Finance and Public Credit - José Antonio Ocampo
source_title: Cámara de Representantes: Reforma tributaria, proyecto de ley 118 de 2022 Cámara (131 de 2022 Senado)
grading_note: The Chamber's bill file lists him as the author (filed 8 August 2022) of the reform whose articles 35 to 37 create the wealth tax. The reform covers many taxes, so this is evidence of authoring the bill that contains the wealth tax, not of a vote on it alone.

design_detail: Signed Ley 2277 de 2022 as Minister of Finance; the law creates the permanent impuesto al patrimonio (72,000 UVT or more).

publisher: Departamento Administrativo de la Función Pública
grading_note: Signs the sanctioned law as the minister responsible. The text reproduces the Diario Oficial signatures.

design_detail: Sanctioned Ley 2277 de 2022 as President of Colombia; the law creates the permanent impuesto al patrimonio (72,000 UVT or more).
source_title: Ley 2277 de 2022 (Gestor Normativo, Función Pública): signature block
publisher: Departamento Administrativo de la Función Pública
grading_note: Signs the sanctioned law as President of the Republic. The reform covers many taxes; the wealth tax is arts. 35 to 37.

design_detail: Defends keeping Colombia's net-wealth tax
quote_original: Salvar al impuesto al patrimonio de la pena de muerte se justifica, entre tanto, por un argumento de equidad.
quote_en: Saving the wealth tax from the death penalty is justified, meanwhile, by an argument of equity.
source_title: Hoy no fío, mañana sí
grading_note: His own column (signed by him) arguing the existing wealth tax should stay on equity grounds; names the tax but no design, so B.

design_detail: Petro reform: tax from COP 3,000 million of personal net wealth; his 2022 own proposal from COP 1,000 million at 0.5% to 2%
quote_original: Creo que el diseño que trae la reforma es bueno, incluso generoso, porque arranca a cobrar solamente para personas que tengan desde $3.000 millones
quote_en: I think the design in the reform is good, even generous, because it only starts charging people with wealth from COP 3,000 million
source_title: Expertos analizan los efectos del impuesto al patrimonio
grading_note: Quoted by name in the article, endorses the named reform's wealth-tax design and threshold; A for specifics.

design_detail: Opposes removing the wealth tax on assets above COP 3,770 million (Bill 477/2026)
quote_original: Resulta indignante que se elimine el impuesto al patrimonio de quienes superan los $3.770 millones
quote_en: It is outrageous that the wealth tax is being eliminated for those who exceed COP 3,770 million
source_title: «Volveremos a las calles»: Mafe Carrascal lanzó advertencia a Abelardo de la Espriella por la Ley de Rescate Económico
grading_note: Her own post on X, quoted verbatim by Infobae (published 6 Nov 2026), objecting to the proposed removal of the wealth tax above the current threshold.

design_detail: Criticises Bill 477/2026 softening the wealth tax and giving it an end date
quote_original: a los más ricos les ablandarán el impuesto al patrimonio y les pondrán fecha de vencimiento
quote_en: they will soften the wealth tax for the richest and give it an expiry date
source_title: Impuestos a la clase media en Colombia: ¿'florero de Llorente' entre De la Espriella y Congreso?
grading_note: Her own words as quoted by Bloomberg Línea; she criticises the softening of the tax, but the position is implied and not an explicit call to keep it.

design_detail: Criticises Bill 477/2026 for easing the wealth tax on large fortunes
quote_original: alivia el impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
quote_en: it eases the tax on large fortunes
source_title: De la Espriella está entre la responsabilidad fiscal y un nuevo estallido social en Colombia
grading_note: Her own words as quoted by Bloomberg Línea (4 Nov 2026); criticism of the easing is clear but the position on the tax itself is implied.

design_detail: Opposes eliminating the wealth tax (announced 7 Aug 2026)
quote_original: Es borrar de tajo una medida básica de la justicia tributaria: que el que más tenga, más pague
quote_en: It is wiping out at a stroke a basic measure of tax justice: that those who have more pay more
source_title: Eliminar el impuesto al patrimonio en Colombia: ¿necesidad o beneficio para los ricos?
grading_note: Her own words, quoted by Bloomberg Línea, explicitly against abolishing the wealth tax.

design_detail: Criticises Bill 477/2026 for exonerating the richest from the wealth tax
quote_original: A los más ricos y pudientes se les exonera, por ejemplo, de la renta y del impuesto al patrimonio
quote_en: The richest and most well-off are exempted, for example, from income tax and the wealth tax
source_title: Iván Cepeda lanza advertencia por el rescate fiscal y señala quiénes podrían verse afectados
grading_note: His own words to EFE. He criticises the easing of the tax, but the position on the tax itself is implied.

design_detail: Argues against eliminating the wealth tax, 'the most progressive of all'
quote_original: no se debe eliminar el impuesto al patrimonio, que es el más progresivo de todos y ayuda a compensar la subestimación de las rentas de capital
quote_en: the wealth tax should not be eliminated; it is the most progressive of all and helps offset the underestimation of capital income
source_title: José Antonio Ocampo le pidió a De la Espriella no eliminar el impuesto al patrimonio
grading_note: Quoted by Infobae from his own El Tiempo column (the column date is not shown; month taken from the Infobae article of 23 Aug 2026).

design_detail: Says cutting the wealth tax is a gift to the richest
quote_original: reducir el 4X.1000 y el impuesto al patrimonio, que son impuestos que pagan los más ricos , es un regalo para ellos en el momento en que se necesitan que paguen más impuestos los más ricos de Colombia
quote_en: cutting the 4x1000 and the wealth tax, which are taxes paid by the richest, is a gift to them just when the richest in Colombia need to pay more taxes
source_title: Gustavo Petro reaccionó a anuncio de ministro de Hacienda de quitar el impuesto al patrimonio y reducir el 4x1.000
grading_note: His own statement, quoted by Infobae, opposing the removal of the wealth tax.

design_detail: Tax on the undeclared offshore wealth of the richest households
quote_original: establecer un impuesto a la riqueza extraterritorial no declarada de los hogares más ricos
quote_en: establish a tax on the undeclared offshore wealth of the richest households
source_title: Oxfam sugiere a Colombia establecer un impuesto a la riqueza en el exterior no declarada
grading_note: Recommendation in Oxfam's Econonuestra report on inequality in Colombia, quoted by Forbes. It covers offshore wealth only, so it is a partial wealth tax.

design_detail: Court intervention asking to uphold arts. 36 and 37 of Ley 2277 (wealth tax base)
quote_original: Dejusticia y la Universidad Libre solicitaron que se declare la exequibilidad de los artículos 36 y 37 de la Ley 2277 de 2022
quote_en: Dejusticia and the Universidad Libre asked the Court to declare articles 36 and 37 of Ley 2277 of 2022 constitutional
source_title: Sentencia C-395 de 2024
grading_note: The Court's own summary of Dejusticia's intervention; the issue was narrow (whether real property may be in the base), so B.

design_detail: Argues the Court should reject the challenges and uphold the wealth tax
quote_original: nosotros apoyamos en general que el Estado grave altos patrimonios líquidos
quote_en: we generally support the State taxing high net wealth
source_title: Column on the Constitutional Court and the wealth tax
grading_note: Own column, co-written with Juan Sebastián Ceballos: explicit support for taxing high net wealth and for the Court validating the tax.

design_detail: Argues the Court should reject the challenges and uphold the wealth tax
quote_original: nosotros apoyamos en general que el Estado grave altos patrimonios líquidos
quote_en: we generally support the State taxing high net wealth
source_title: Column on the Constitutional Court and the wealth tax
grading_note: Own column, co-written with Rodrigo Uprimny: explicit support for taxing high net wealth and for the Court validating the tax.

design_detail: One-off extraordinary wealth tax on net wealth above COP 1,000 million, progressive 1% to 10%
quote_original: El impuesto al patrimonio extraordinario propuesto podría ser por una sola vez y recaería preferentemente sobre las personas naturales con un patrimonio líquido superior a $1.000 millones
quote_en: The proposed extraordinary wealth tax could be levied once only and would fall preferably on individuals with net wealth above COP 1,000 million
source_title: El impuesto extraordinario a la riqueza: una fuente de financiación idónea de medidas de emergencia ante la pandemia del COVID-19
grading_note: Co-authored proposal of a one-off wealth levy; the quoted sentence says 'could be', but the paper's title and body argue for it.

design_detail: Wealth tax on individuals (and companies), rates 1.0% to 4.8% above COP 1,000 million
quote_original: Aplicar un impuesto al patrimonio a las PN
quote_en: Apply a wealth tax to natural persons
source_title: Propuesta de Proceso de Reforma Tributaria Estructural para Colombia
grading_note: First-stage measure in the authors' structural tax reform proposal, with a rate table and revenue estimate.

design_detail: Creates a wealth tax above COP 2,000 million for ten years, mean rate 0.38%
quote_original: La propuesta consiste en “crear” un impuesto para patrimonios líquidos superiores a los $2 mil millones de pesos
quote_en: The proposal is to 'create' a tax on net wealth above COP 2 billion
source_title: Impuesto al Patrimonio: solución al problema financiero de las Universidades Públicas
grading_note: Own proposal in a signed paper: a ten-year wealth tax to fund public universities.

design_detail: Opposes eliminating the wealth tax (announced 7 Aug 2026)
quote_original: Eliminarlo solo indica una cosa: menos impuestos para los ricos y más impuestos para los pobres
quote_en: Eliminating it only means one thing: less tax for the rich and more tax for the poor
source_title: Críticas y aplausos a propuesta del 'Tigre' sobre eliminar impuesto a los ricos
grading_note: His own words, quoted by La Nación, explicitly against eliminating the wealth tax.

design_detail: Criticises the plan to remove the wealth tax from the 'megarich'
quote_original: quitarles el impuesto al patrimonio a los megarricos de Colombia
quote_en: removing the wealth tax from Colombia's megarich
source_title: Críticas y aplausos a propuesta del 'Tigre' sobre eliminar impuesto a los ricos
grading_note: His own words as quoted by La Nación; he criticises the removal, but the position is implied.

design_detail: Filed the Petro government's tax reform bill (Proyecto 004/2026 Cámara) adjusting the wealth tax; INCP reports the threshold cut from 72,000 to 40,000 UVT
quote_original: la reforma que fue radicada por el exministro de Hacienda Germán Ávila
quote_en: the reform filed by former Finance Minister Germán Ávila
source_title: Impuesto al patrimonio: ¿cómo funciona y por qué De la Espriella quiere eliminarlo?
grading_note: A journalist's narration of the filing (bill text not opened); filing date and threshold change are from INCP's report of 20 July 2026.

design_detail: Co-filed Proyecto de Ley 310/2020 Senado (renta básica de emergencia), whose motives pledge a progressive wealth tax on net wealth from COP 2,000 million
source_title: Proyecto de Ley 310 de 2020 Senado (renta básica de emergencia): authors
grading_note: Named among the 53 senators who filed the bill on 27 May 2020. Its motives (Gaceta 257 of 2020, https://normograma.com/legibus/legibus/gacetas/2020/GC_0257_2020.pdf), written in the signatories' name, say they will present a structural tax reform with a progressive wealth tax on net wealth from COP 2,000 million; the bill itself finances a basic income.
